description: Work with Google Forms the way agents work: task-shaped tools that finish in one call. Creating a form takes its questions along, questions are added/edited/deleted by ID or by title (resolved inside the connector), and responses come back with answers keyed by question title — no multi-call choreography.

inputs.description: Where the API is; it must be allowed below
inputs.name: api_base
inputs.title: API base URL

instructions: createForm takes the form's questions along — describe them with simple types (text, paragraph, multipleChoice, checkboxes, dropdown, scale, date, time). Questions resolve by ID or title in later calls. getResponses keys answers by question title; publishForm makes the form accept responses.
